critical_code_review_comments: server.py lines ~2079-2150 (barcode-safe union) — the two-source merge (matches set + by_sku[barcode_candidates] set) is provably additive: barcode_candidates only ever gates IN, never OUT. Test test_market_coverage_is_additive_only enforces this across the full catalogue.

server.py lines ~2217-2245 (has_competitor_pricing gate) — uses num_priced_competitors>=1 as the boolean. This is the right contract because the previous gate on num_competitors would have flipped TRUE for stores that carry the product but have no in-window price (OOS without price, expired snapshots), inflating matched_products by a different definition.

matcher.py:_has_pack_indicator (lines 117-140) — PACK_TOKEN_SPLIT_RE excludes letter characters by design so compound Arabic words like 'متعددة' (multiple) and 'كرتونية' (cardboard-adj) stay as one token. The regex includes ×, [], (), |, /, _, -, comma, dot, semicolon, colon — exhaustive enough that hand-curated test cases (Backpack/package/متعدد/كرتونية) all pass.

Test test_iteration20_api_contract.py:TestKpiBlockIter20 uses widened tolerances (±~25 on matched_products, ±~1.5 on market_coverage_pct, ±10 on share_sample_size) — these are intentionally loose to absorb day-to-day snapshot churn from the live crawler. PACK_KEYWORDS still includes 'عدد' (line 25). The word-boundary fix in _has_pack_indicator protects against substring collisions, but PACK_AR_RE (line 24) still matches 'عدد\s*\d+' via regex — that's correct since legitimate 'عدد 12' phrasing needs to fire. The two paths are independently safe.

rca_of_the_issue: Two compounding root causes: (1) The matcher.py _has_pack_indicator function used naive substring matching against PACK_KEYWORDS, which included 'عدد' (Arabic for 'number/count'). The Beaphar Arabic name contains 'متعددة' (= 'multiple', a vitamin descriptor), which has 'عدد' as a substring — so matcher silently classified Beaphar as a multipack and SKIPPED Level-1 (barcode) matching for it. Result: only 1 SKU-method match instead of the 7+ legitimate barcode matches. Affected 58 of 2466 my_products (2.4%) by the same Arabic/English substring collision class. Fixed by tokenizing on whitespace+punctuation (PACK_TOKEN_SPLIT_RE) and checking keyword membership at the token level. (2) Even after the matcher heal, the /api/my-products row builder read num_competitors only from the stale product_matches link table. The detail panel read directly from product_snapshots so it could see the 6 Beaphar competitors immediately. Fixed by unioning the matches set with snapshot stores whose SKU passes _is_valid_barcode (^\d{8,14}$) AND equals my_barcode/my_sku exactly. The exact-match + barcode-shape gate prevents Zid-suffix false positives (8005852750068-RUDC can never be unioned for 8005852750068 because the suffixed string is in a different by_sku bucket). Reproduction: GET /api/my-products?search=8711231124985 → before fix: num_competitors=0; after fix: num_competitors>=6, with prices ~40-48 SAR. Mitigation locked in by test_competitor_count_union.py (11 tests) + test_matcher_pack_indicator.py (10 tests) + test_iteration20_api_contract.py (28 tests).
